items.snippet:
Desi Perkins is a Mexican-American beauty influencer and entrepreneur, renowned for her successful ventures in the skincare and fashion industries. Born in Los Angeles on March 3, 1987, she initially rose to fame through makeup tutorials on YouTube and Instagram. Her engaging content and brand collaborations earned her a vast following—over 4 million followers on Instagram, 3.18 million YouTube subscribers, and 500,000 TikTok followers as of August 2024.

Together with her husband, Steven Perkins, whom she married in 2012, Desi co-founded two popular brands: Dezi, a sunglasses line, and Dezi Skin, a skincare company. These ventures have also garnered significant social media traction, reflecting their strong fanbase.

In addition to her business and influencer success, Desi is also a mother of two. She and Steven welcomed their first child, a son, in 2020, after openly sharing their fertility struggles with followers—a story that resonated with many. In 2023, they expanded their family with the birth of a daughter. Desi continues to share her beauty expertise, entrepreneurial journey, and family life with her devoted audience.
items.title: Who is Desi Perkins? Meet the Mexican skincare and sunglasses CEO with millions of followers on social media

items.snippet:
Lorna Luxe, born Lorna Andrews in 1989 in Greater Manchester, is a highly influential UK fashion influencer and successful entrepreneur. Initially working as Virgin Atlantic cabin crew and later for a homeware retailer, she rose to prominence through Instagram, where her unique "headless" fashion photography and candid discussions about personal struggles, including eating disorders and hair loss, resonated with followers. With over 2 million followers by 2026, she built a strong personal brand known for style, transparency, and relatability.

Lorna leveraged her online presence into fashion collaborations and eventually launched her own brand, L.A-Space, in 2023. Known for its stylish lifestyle products, the brand quickly gained traction, releasing successful items like the fragrance Ghost No. 98 and launching in luxury retailers like Selfridges.

She is married to John Andrews, a former banker who became her business partner. The couple, married since 2010, lives in Warwickshire. John has battled adrenal cancer since 2023, with several health complications. Despite his ongoing illness, they focus on enjoying life together, appreciating their time, and balancing work and personal joy.
